- Downloads, Series and movies: an add-on whose server has a certificate the phone does not trust ("Trust anchor for certification path not found": a self-made certificate, or a server that sends an incomplete chain) is no longer just an error. The screen shows the server and the certificate's fingerprint (SHA-256) and a "Trust this server" button; only when you press it, that one certificate is accepted for that one server (any other certificate of it is still refused). Nothing is trusted silently, and the other servers are checked as before.
- Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF): a document opened from another app (a file manager, a mail or chat app, the Files app's "Open with") was never listed under Recent, so it could not be opened again from there; only the ones opened from Pulse's own file manager were. Every document is now listed. When the other app's permission to read the file can be made lasting it is kept as a link; otherwise a copy (up to 40 MB, the last 15 documents) is kept in the app's own folder, so it opens again from Recent. Removing an entry from Recent also removes its kept copy.
- Downloads, Series and movies: more than one add-on can be kept (each a link you give; Pulse brings none). Every add-on is asked for the streams of an episode, one after the other, and their streams are put together: when one is down, refuses or has nothing, the others still answer, and the error is only shown when none did. Each add-on has a Remove button and "Add another add-on" adds the next. A link, magnet link or .torrent file can still be pasted straight into the Downloads page.
- Downloads, Series and movies: the pictures are sharp now (the catalogue's 100 pixel posters were stretched: the 500 pixel ones are used, kept at twice the size they are shown), a season shows a wide cover of its own (its first episode's picture, the season and the episode count over it) instead of a tiny box, episode pictures are bigger, and the lists have more room. Each add-on is checked when it is added or the card opens: its manifest is read and its name is shown with a tick, or the reason it does not work (a wrong link, a server that is down, an untrusted certificate, no streams) with a cross, instead of an empty list later.
- Office (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), phone held sideways: the top menu (tabs, File, the menus of the older looks) did not open when tapped. The top block hides itself sideways and shows for 2 seconds after a tap, but the same tap also flipped the hand switch of the bar, so it often stayed hidden, and a menu that did open was taken away with the block after the 2 seconds. The tap now only does the one job, and the block stays while a menu or the File panel is open (it goes 2 seconds after they close).
